nodes.label: WhatsApp Ops Design System
nodes.rationale: Defines an operational SaaS interface for SMEs where WhatsApp conversations, sales, inventory, and human-controlled AI work together.

nodes.label: Reviewable AI Assistance
nodes.rationale: AI suggestions must be visibly distinct from executed human actions and include reason, confidence, data source, and review actions.

nodes.label: Sales and Inventory Workflow
nodes.rationale: The product vision describes human-managed and agent-assisted sales flows with inventory deduction, traceability, pending-sale notifications, rollback, and handoff after payment.

nodes.label: Backend API Boundary
nodes.rationale: Browser code must use the centralized HTTP client and internal backend routes instead of directly consuming Meta APIs.

nodes.label: Modular Frontend Structure
nodes.rationale: Feature modules remain under src/factures while truly shared types, clients, services, and reusable components belong in src/shared.

nodes.label: HTTP and Socket Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: HTTP is the reliable source for initial loading and recovery, while Socket.IO supplies live updates that must remain reconcilable with the API.

nodes.label: Frontend Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: The frontend must not expose Meta credentials, direct Graph API calls, sensitive logs, or backend-enforced permission boundaries.

nodes.label: Operational UI Rules
nodes.rationale: The UI is optimized for repeat operational work with clear states, responsive stable layouts, and actionable errors.

nodes.label: Clean Code Skill
nodes.rationale: Code should be understandable and safely changeable by developers other than its original author.

nodes.label: Stable Event Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Event callbacks stored in refs prevent effects from resubscribing whenever a handler identity changes.

nodes.label: Single App Initialization
nodes.rationale: App-wide initialization should be guarded at module scope because components may remount and rerun empty-dependency effects.

nodes.label: Stable Callback Refs
nodes.rationale: useEffectEvent accesses current callback values without unnecessary effect reruns or stale closures.

nodes.label: Parallel API Route Work
nodes.rationale: Independent API route operations should begin early and be awaited only when their results are needed.

nodes.label: Deferred Await
nodes.rationale: Await work only inside branches that require it so fast-return paths do not block on unused operations.

nodes.label: Dependency Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: Partially dependent tasks should start as early as possible and converge through dependency-aware parallel execution.

nodes.label: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.norm_label: use passive event listeners for scrolling performance

nodes.label: Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass
nodes.norm_label: use flatmap to map and filter in one pass

nodes.label: Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
nodes.norm_label: build index maps for repeated lookups

nodes.label: Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
nodes.norm_label: early length check for array comparisons

nodes.label: Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
nodes.norm_label: use loop for min/max instead of sort

nodes.label: Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
nodes.norm_label: use tosorted() instead of sort() for immutability

nodes.norm_label: how we optimized package imports in next.js

nodes.label: Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element
nodes.rationale: Animating a wrapper div lets browsers use GPU acceleration for smoother SVG transform and transition animations.
nodes.norm_label: animate svg wrapper instead of svg element

nodes.label: Use Explicit Conditional Rendering
nodes.rationale: Explicit ternaries prevent falsy numeric values such as 0 and NaN from being rendered unintentionally.

nodes.label: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
nodes.rationale: content-visibility:auto defers layout and paint work for off-screen list items to accelerate initial rendering.

nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Static JSX should be created outside a component so it can be reused instead of recreated on every render.

nodes.label: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: A synchronous pre-hydration script applies client-only state before display, avoiding SSR failures, flicker, and hydration mismatch.

nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: suppressHydrationWarning is limited to intentionally different server and client text, and must not conceal real mismatches.

nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: React DOM resource APIs initiate DNS, connections, downloads, and execution early for anticipated resources.

nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.rationale: defer preserves order after parsing for dependent scripts, while async is for independent scripts and prevents render blocking.
nodes.norm_label: use defer or async on script tags

nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reducing coordinate precision decreases SVG file size while preserving suitable visual fidelity.

nodes.label: Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States
nodes.rationale: useTransition supplies pending state and manages interruptible non-urgent updates without manual loading-state bookkeeping.
nodes.norm_label: use usetransition over manual loading states

nodes.label: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
nodes.rationale: Dynamic values used only during a callback should be read on demand to avoid subscribing the component to every state change.
nodes.norm_label: defer state reads to usage point

nodes.label: Narrow Effect Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Effects should depend on the smallest primitive or derived value that represents the condition requiring a rerun.

nodes.label: Calculate Derived State During Rendering
nodes.rationale: Values computable from current props and state should be derived during render, preventing redundant effects, renders, and state drift.

nodes.label: Subscribe to Derived State
nodes.rationale: Subscribing to a meaningful derived boolean avoids rerendering for continuous source-value changes that do not alter UI state.

nodes.label: Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Functional updates access current state safely, preventing stale closures and allowing stable callbacks with fewer dependencies.

nodes.label: Use Lazy State Initialization
nodes.rationale: Expensive initial state calculations belong in the function form of useState so they execute only during initialization.

nodes.label: Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
nodes.rationale: Non-primitive default props must be shared constants so memoized components receive stable references across rerenders.
nodes.norm_label: extract default non-primitive parameter value from memoized component to constant

nodes.label: Extract to Memoized Components
nodes.rationale: Expensive work can be isolated in a memoized child so parent early returns skip that work entirely.

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
nodes.rationale: Effects caused by a specific interaction should execute in that interaction handler to avoid accidental repeats from unrelated state changes.
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers

nodes.label: Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: Nested component declarations create a new component type on each parent render, causing remounts and loss of child state.

nodes.label: Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in usememo

nodes.label: Avoid useMemo for Simple Primitive Expressions
nodes.rationale: Calling useMemo and comparing dependencies can consume more resources than a simple expression with a primitive result.
nodes.norm_label: avoid usememo for simple primitive expressions

nodes.label: Split Independent Hook Computations
nodes.rationale: Independent tasks should have separate dependency sets so a changed dependency does not recompute or rerun unrelated work.

nodes.label: Transition Non-Urgent State Updates
nodes.rationale: Frequent non-urgent updates should be transitions so React can keep the user interface responsive.

nodes.label: Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders
nodes.norm_label: use usedeferredvalue for expensive derived renders

nodes.label: Defer Expensive Derived Renders
nodes.rationale: A deferred value lets React prioritize input updates while rendering expensive derived results when idle; the expensive computation must be memoized against the deferred value.

nodes.label: Store Transient Values in Refs
nodes.rationale: Refs are appropriate for frequently changing DOM-adjacent values that should not trigger a component re-render; state remains for UI.
